fields.description: The fields specified in the case configuration are not used and are not propagated to individual cases, therefore it is recommended to set it to `null`.

id.description: The identifier for the connector. If you do not want a default connector, use `none`. To retrieve connector IDs, use the find connectors API.

name.description: The name of the connector. If you do not want a default connector, use `none`. To retrieve connector names, use the find connectors API.

defaultValue.description: A default value for the custom field. If the `type` is `text`, the default value must be a string. If the `type` is `toggle`, the default value must be boolean.

key.description: A unique key for the custom field. Must be lower case and composed only of a-z, 0-9, '_', and '-' characters. It is used in API calls to refer to a specific custom field.

label.description: The custom field label that is displayed in the case.

type.description: The type of the custom field.

required.description: Indicates whether the field is required. If `false`, the custom field can be set to null or omitted when a case is created or updated.
